messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high p99 latency detected on dedicated-pool-west-1 (model-x-large). p99 = 4.2s > SLO(2s). Queue depth spike. Dashboard: http://dash.redwood.internal/d/latency/8271600000 :rotating_light:
ops-rotation (oncall): acked. I'm on it, paging infra and triage. @samir @jia can you grab traces + pool health?
samir: looking now — streaming stalls visible, p95 ~700ms but p99 up to 4.2s. queue_depth ~320 on pool. GPU util at ~99% on 12 nodes, all warmup states stuck = true for many sessions. kv-cache cold_miss_rate jumped.
jia: any autoscaler events? run: `rate(redwood_autoscaler_scale_events_total[2m])` ? also grab `sum(rate(reqs[1m])) by (pool)`
samir: pasted query output (snip):
```
# sum(rate(requests[1m])) by (pool)
dedicated-pool-west-1  ->  250 r/s
hosted-pool-west-1     ->   40 r/s
```
# autoscaler events: last scale request at 8271599940, scale_applied at 8271600032 (92s delay).
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:10Z] autoscaler: scale_request(pool=dedicated-pool-west-1, want=16)
[2026-03-15T09:13:42Z] autoscaler: scale_applied(pool=dedicated-pool-west-1, actual=16)
```
maria: confirmed in autoscaler logs — handshake jitter caused by warmup handshake timeouts. warmup tasks are getting queued behind a burst of hotshot initializations. we see cold-init times spike to 30–45s (normally <3s).
eva-triage: suggested mitigations (prioritized):
1) enable emergency-burst on pool to allow hotshot immediate start (bypass some warmup gating)
2) route lower-priority customers to hosted fallback model-x-small until warmup stabilizes
3) throttle or deprioritize heavy eval traffic (if present)
4) if p99 doesn't fall within 3 min, add 4 hotshot nodes manually
please call the customer-impact channel after action 1/2. :+1:
ops-rotation (oncall): executing 1 & 2 now. running CLI: `redwood infra pool set --name dedicated-pool-west-1 --emergency-burst=true` then `redwood route update --pool dedicated-pool-west-1 --fallback hosted-pool-west-1:model-x-small --prio lower=deprio`
console-bot: `APPLY: emergency-burst=true` for dedicated-pool-west-1 — ACK from control-plane. Routing changes pushed, 80% of newly arrived requests now eligible for fallback.
samir: queue depth already dropping to ~120 after routing change. streaming stall traces still show long KV miss tails for in-flight sessions (long-context). might need to speculative-cache prefix for some heavy-callers.
maria: i'm going to add 4 hotshot nodes as temporary: `redwood infra pool scale --pool dedicated-pool-west-1 --add 4 --mode hotshot` — doing now.
console-bot: added 4 hotshot nodes (node-221..node-224). health checks passing.
jia: customer telemetry — acme-corp (prod) shows 15% error increase and 20% latency degradation on requests to model-x-large. CS notified.
eva-triage: please page CS and account team, set customer-impact = P1 for acme-corp for now. include mitigation: routed them to hosted model-x-small; ask if they want rollback or tolerance.
ops-rotation (oncall): paging CS & Account — `@cs-team @acct-team acme-corp impacted, we've routed them to fallback model-x-small and enabled emergency burst. ETA for stabilization ~5–10m. Will follow up.`
console-bot: post-update: p95 now ~520ms, p99 ~1.9s. queue depth trending down to 60. streaming stalls reduced but KV cold_miss still ~12% above baseline.
samir: still seeing some tail cases for long-context sessions (context length > 8k). they hit cold path on new hotshot nodes — warming KV caches will take a few rounds. recommend leaving emergency-burst on for 30m and monitor.
maria: added a short-lived workaround: prefix-cache speculation enabled for dedicated-pool-west-1 (speculative true, ttl 5m) — hopes to prefill heavy keys.
jia: logs show autoscaler handshake improvement after nodes joined, handshake delay now ~10s. that explains most of the earlier 90s lag.
eva-triage: decision: keep emergency-burst on, keep fallback routing for non-SLA customers, leave hotshot nodes for 45m, and schedule a controlled warmup roll of 3 nodes to prepopulate KV caches. assign postmortem to maria.
ops-rotation (oncall): creating incident ticket INC-827160 in tracker, severity=P1 (customer-visible). linking dashboard snapshots and routing diffs.
maria: ack — will own postmortem. immediate next steps (in ticket):
- investigate why handshake gating didn't allow soft-start (possible regression in warmup handshake timeout tuning)
- assess whether autoscaler should prioritize hotshot fast-path for cold pools
- evaluate prefix-cache defaults for long-context customers
- propose runbook edits for emergency-burst toggles & customer routing
samir: one more note — observed a small backlog in request-serialization on the TPU adapter layer during the peak. might be unrelated but will include in debug dump.
ops-rotation (oncall): monitoring. will update in 15m or when p99 < 1.5s for 5m. thanks all for quick responses. :clap:
console-bot: UPDATE @ 8271600540 — p95 480ms, p99 1.4s, queue depth 18, emergency-burst still ON. issue degrading.
eva-triage: good. keep oncall notified, assign followups to infra/serving and shipping a postmortem.
maria: thanks — saving logs and will start postmortem doc. I'll include timeline + config diffs + command history.
ops-rotation (oncall): closing live mitigation phase. leaving emergency-burst until postmortem recommendations. if anyone sees regression or re-spike, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
